name: Independent-Kinetic Screened Preferred-Frame with Auxiliary Chi
claimed_mechanism: The auxiliary chi implements the frozen mu(y)=1-e^-y MOND relation, while a khronon K supplies the unremovable A_0 sector required for relativistic lensing. A multiplier s weights only the preferred-frame alpha coupling to u_mu, K, and A_mu, so the screened response scales as e^-y in the coupling sector. The finite propagating mode is carried by A_mu with an independent standard kinetic term, so its normalization is not tied to the screened alpha coupling or to G. This preserves a single matter-coupled metric and avoids rescaling G while attacking the P7 collision.
predicted_weak_field: In the galactic low-acceleration regime, chi produces the frozen MOND scaling and K gives the Bekenstein A_0 contribution to lensing. In high-density solar-system fields, e^-y suppresses the preferred-frame alpha coupling, screening fifth-force and preferred-frame violations. The A_mu mode retains a finite canonical kinetic normalization and well-defined propagation, so the screened limit does not remove the propagating sector. The result is MONDian galactic dynamics and lensing with screened solar-system behavior.
inequivalence_argument: DC-001, the local no-preferred-frame lensing MOND dead class, was fatal because a local non-preferred-frame coupling could be removed without an unremovable A_0, and no field of type khronon was present. This candidate is structurally different: it contains an explicit khronon K that appears in a preferred-frame, lapse-weighted, e^-y-screened coupling, providing the required unremovable A_0 lensing sector. The finite propagating kinetic normalization is carried by an independent standard-kinetic A_mu, not by the screened alpha coupling, so alpha can scale as e^-y without degenerating the propagating mode. Therefore it does not match DC-001 or any coefficient-tweak variant of the killed local no-khronon architectures.
